newsitem.title: USA: Lasertechnics sees $1.4 mln Q1 operating loss.
newsitem.headline: Lasertechnics sees $1.4 mln Q1 operating loss.

text.p: Lasertechnics Inc said Wednesday that based on preliminary indications, its operating loss for the first quarter of 1997 will be about $1.4 million, compared with $1.75 million in the first quarter of 1996 and $2.5 million in the fourth quarter of 1996.
The company added that operating losses have been on a declining trend since the second quarter of last year.

Lasertechnics also said that it expects consolidated revenue for the first quarter to be slightly in excess of the $4.1 million posted a year ago and up sharply from the $2.8 million recorded in the fourth quarter last year.

The company said its 1997 business plan was developed on the premise that the company would not need to raise additional permanent capital. Results for the first quarter were ahead of plan in all material respects and the company said it expects it will have sufficient working capital to execute its operating plan for the year.
